notes: Roll-up of the 45 point masses of the H4_12S sizing result (mass_model.rollup). The sizing owns the mass model until a SpecSheet exists (ADR 0022).
Own inertia added for tail_boom, fuselage, battery and the two lift booms (the rules of model.QuadplaneModel). Every other item is a point mass.
The sizing result gives Ixx 2.9374, Iyy 3.8520, Izz 6.7595 kg m^2. Its Ixx is about y = 0 and z = 0, not about the CG height. This roll-up is about the CG.
The sizing CG x is 0.139148 m (neutral point less the static margin target).
Quadplane. S, b and c: the Currawong wing (copied from aircraft/currawong). The design frame has the wing root leading edge at x = 0.
MRP = the sized CG of the mass model. x = neutral point (vortex lattice) less the static margin target times c_ref. It is a sizing value (placeholder).

performance.name: sizing
performance.description: Rosella sizing, case H4_12S (H4, 12S), level L4. Minimum mission energy under the limits of the settings. Active constraints: motor_torque_front, motor_current_front, duty_front, duty_rear, energy_Wh, clear_fuselage_m, clear_rear_to_wing_TE_m, control_yaw_rad_s2. 45 settings values are stand-ins (the result file lists them).
